config.aeog.title: Anvil Enchantment Ordering Guide
config.aeog.autoDetectItem.tooltip: When enabled, placing an item in the anvil's left slot will automatically skip Phase 1 and open Phase 2 for that item.
config.aeog.autoFillMode.tooltip:
Max Levels:
Automatically selects the maximum level for every enchantment (excluding curses).

From Inventory:
Selects levels based on enchanted books currently in your inventory.
config.aeog.allowIncompatible.tooltip: Removes grouping and disabling of incompatible enchantments in Phase 2. Only useful if you have a mod/datapack that overrides vanilla incompatibility rules.
config.aeog.phase3ViewMode.tooltip: Choose how merge steps are displayed in Phase 3.
config.aeog.showModButtonPhase1.tooltip: When enabled, a button appears in Phase 1 to switch between vanilla and modded items.
config.aeog.showModButtonPhase2.tooltip: When enabled, a button appears in Phase 2 to show or hide modded enchantments.
